snippet.title: Shole Soccer Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4987170/Shole_Soccer/

Shole Soccer is a chaotic online soccer game where ball obeys physics - and your friends don't obey rules. Kick, stun or tackle your way to victory over your friends.
